items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Playoff
items.text: Joaquin Niemann birdied the first playoff hole to defeat Talor Gooch for his first LIV Golf title of 2026 and eighth career LIV win at LIV Golf Korea.

items.headline: Stout Leads NCAA Championship
items.text: Preston Stout leads the NCAA Men's Golf Championship at 11-under, one shot ahead after a third-round 65, positioning himself for a potential Masters invite.
